svg.title: lightweight gate mechanism
svg.desc: A scalar gate per image and feature level. Full RGB and infrared spatial feature tensors bypass a separate thin-line weight path consisting of GAP, concatenation, a 512-to-32-to-1 MLP and sigmoid. Alpha and one minus alpha weight the full tensors, whose sum is multiplied by two. The output has the same B by 256 by H by W shape. The 256-channel MLP is an illustrative configuration, not a verified implementation snapshot.
svg.title: lightweight_gate_mechanism
